First, I processed WA BRFSS County-level data. 
```{r}
# load data
brfss2023 <- read.csv("C:/Users/pxp3303/OneDrive - Washington State Executive Branch Agencies/BRFSS/WA_BRFSS_2023.csv")
brfss2021 <- read.csv("C:/Users/pxp3303/OneDrive - Washington State Executive Branch Agencies/BRFSS/BRFSS2021.csv")
brfss2019 <- read_dta("C:/Users/pxp3303/OneDrive - Washington State Executive Branch Agencies/BRFSS/WA_BRFSS_2019_v2.dta")
names(brfss2019) <- gsub("^_", "X_", names(brfss2019))
brfss2019 <- brfss2019 %>% rename(bphigh6 = bphigh4)
brfss2023$Year <- 2023
brfss2021$Year <- 2021
brfss2019$Year <- 2019


brfss19_21 <- merge(brfss2019, brfss2021, all.x = TRUE, all.y = TRUE)
BRFSS <- merge(brfss19_21, brfss2023, all.x = TRUE, all.y = TRUE)

# get weight by year to create combined weight
prop.table(table(BRFSS$Year))

BRFSS <- BRFSS %>%
  mutate(c_wt= if_else(Year == 2019, X_llcpwt * 0.2471,
                                    if_else(Year == 2021, X_llcpwt * 0.2499,
                                            if_else(Year == 2023, X_llcpwt * 0.5029, NA_real_))))

# clean hypertension variable
BRFSS$highbp <- ifelse(BRFSS$bphigh6 == 1, 1, 
                     ifelse(BRFSS$bphigh6 %in% c(2,3,4), 0, NA))
table(BRFSS$highbp, useNA = "always")
table(BRFSS$X_impcty, BRFSS$highbp, useNA = "always")

# clean BRFSS data 
BRFSS <- subset(BRFSS, !is.na(BRFSS$X_impcty & !is.na(BRFSS$highbp)))

WaCounty <- st_read("data/wacounty.shp")
WaCounty <- st_as_sf(WaCounty)
mat <- adjacency_matrix(WaCounty)
colnames(mat) <- rownames(mat) <- WaCounty$HRA2010v2_
mat <- as.matrix(mat[1:dim(mat)[1], 1:dim(mat)[1]])
mat[1:2, 1:2]

# Set up survey design
options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")
design <- svydesign(
  ids = ~X_psu, weights = ~c_wt,
  strata = ~X_ststr, data = BRFSS
  )

# Direct estimates
table(BRFSS$X_impcty, BRFSS$highbp)
direct <- svyby(
  ~highbp,
  ~X_impcty,
  design  = design,
  FUN     = svymean,
  na.rm   = TRUE,
  vartype = "se")

# Map weighted estimates and se
colnames(direct) <- c("CNTY", "p_hat_w", "se_w")

# Merge the weighted estimates into the WaCounty sf object
WaCounty_mapped <- merge(WaCounty, 
                           direct, 
                           by = "CNTY", 
                           all.x = TRUE)

# Map of direct estimates
mapPlot(data = WaCounty_mapped, 
        geo = WaCounty, 
        variables = "p_hat_w", 
        labels = "Weighted Hypertension Prevalence",
        by.data = "CNTY", 
        by.geo = "CNTY")

# Map of Standard Errors
mapPlot(data = WaCounty_mapped, 
        geo = WaCounty, 
        variables = "se_w", 
        labels = "Standard Error of Weighted Estimates",
        by.data = "CNTY", 
        by.geo = "CNTY")

```


```{r}
if(!isTRUE(requireNamespace("INLA", quietly = TRUE))) {
  install.packages("INLA", 
                  repos = c(getOption("repos"), 
                            INLA = "https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable"), 
                  dep = TRUE)}

FHmodel <- smoothSurvey(
  data = BRFSS, geo = WaCounty, Amat = NULL, response.type = "binary",
  responseVar = "highbp", strataVar = "X_ststr", weightVar = "c_wt",
  regionVar = "X_impcty", clusterVar = "~X_psu", CI = 0.95
  )
FHmodel$fit$summary.fixed[1:5]

# smooth 
svysmoothed <- smoothSurvey(
data = BRFSS, geo = WaCounty, Amat = mat, response.type = "binary",
responseVar = "diab2", strataVar = "strata", weightVar = "rwt_llcp",
regionVar = "hracode", clusterVar = "~1", CI = 0.95
)
svysmoothed$fit$summary.fixed[1:5]
svysmoothed$fit$summary.hyper[1:2, 1:5]
sqrt(1 / svysmoothed$fit$summary.hyper[1, 3:5])

fh_results <- svysmoothed$smooth
fh_results$sd <- sqrt(fh_results$var) # SD is the square root of variance

# Prepare for mapping 
colnames(fh_results)[which(colnames(fh_results) == "region")] <- "HRA2010v2_"

# Merge with the spatial data
WaCounty_FH <- merge(WaCounty, fh_results, by = "HRA2010v2_")

# Map 1: Posterior Means of Smoking Prevalence (pi)
mapPlot(data = WaCounty_FH, 
        geo = WaCounty, 
        variables = "mean", 
        labels = "Posterior Mean (Smoothed pi)",
        by.data = "HRA2010v2_", 
        by.geo = "HRA2010v2_")

# Map 2: Posterior Standard Deviations of pi
mapPlot(data = WaCounty_FH, 
        geo = WaCounty, 
        variables = "sd", 
        labels = "Posterior SD (Smoothed pi)",
        by.data = "HRA2010v2_", 
        by.geo = "HRA2010v2_")

```

Question 2(c): 
```{r}
est <- data.frame(
  weighted = svysmoothed$direct$direct.est,
  weightedsmooth = svysmoothed$smooth$median
)

var <- data.frame(
  weighted = svysmoothed$direct$direct.var,
  weightedsmooth = svysmoothed$smooth$var
)

l1 <- range(est)
l2 <- range(var)

g1 <- ggplot(est, aes(x = weighted, y = weightedsmooth)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red") +
  ggtitle("Survey Wtd Ests") +
  xlab("Direct") +
  ylab("Smoothed") +
  xlim(l1) +
  ylim(l1)

g2 <- ggplot(var, aes(x = weighted, y = weightedsmooth)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red") +
  ggtitle("Survey Wtd Vars") +
  xlab("Direct") +
  ylab("Smoothed") +
  xlim(l2) +
  ylim(l2)

ggpubr::ggarrange(g1, g2)

```
